newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast spot products flat as buying lightens.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast spot products flat as buying lightens.

text.p: Pipeline prices for U.S. West Coast refined petroleum products stayed flat Thursday, with gasoline futures in August sharply lower and local refineries buying very little, traders said.
With trade light, CARB regular unleaded gasoline rose about 1.50 cents a gallon to put late day prices at 69.50/71 cents a gallon in Los Angeles.
Premium, or octane, gasoline stood $0.07 a gallon higher than regular grade.
The August gasoline contract price fell 2.06 cents a gallon to 67.84 cents on its last day of trade. Prices fell after traders sold off the expiring contract.
Other products were notionally flat and Seattle gasoline stood 0.50 cents over Los Angeles conventional grade, which is sold into Nevada.
